auth_mode.label: Authentication mode
auth_mode.description: Choose between automatic local CLI token or dashboard password.

cli_token_path.label: CLI secrets directory
cli_token_path.description: Path to folder containing machine-id and auth/cli-secret (default ~/.9router).

dashboard_password.label: Dashboard password
dashboard_password.description: Password used to authenticate with 9Router dashboard.

dashboard_host.label: Dashboard host
dashboard_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the 9Router server (e.g. localhost, 127.0.0.1).

base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Full base URL of the 9Router server.

refresh_seconds.label: Heartbeat refresh interval (s)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to poll for status updates if the stream disconnects.

show_model_label.label: Show model name in bar
show_model_label.description: Show model text in the bar pill. If off, only shows the status glyph.

remember_password.label: Remember dashboard password
remember_password.description: Store dashboard password in login keyring for automatic re-login.

busy_hold_seconds.label: Active hold duration (s)
busy_hold_seconds.description: How long to keep the active glow after a request finishes.
